title: How a Raft cluster commits one write
purpose: See why a write is safe only after a majority of servers store it.
sequence_reason: The commit depends on an ordered chain of messages, so motion shows the cause and effect better than one static diagram.
summary: A client sends a write to the leader. The leader appends it to its log and sends it to two followers. When a majority stores the entry, the leader commits it and replies to the client.
explanation: The leader replies only after a majority of servers store the entry. A minority failure cannot lose a committed write.

learning_check.question: In a five-server cluster, how many servers must store an entry before the leader can commit it?
learning_check.answer: Three, a majority of five, including the leader.

scenes.heading: One write, three servers
scenes.narration: A Raft cluster commits a write in a fixed order. Watch one write travel.

scenes.heading: The leader appends, then replicates
scenes.narration: The client sends the write to the leader. The leader appends it to its log, then sends AppendEntries to each follower.

path.label: Each follower gets the same entry from the leader.
The leader sends to Follower 2 directly, not through Follower 1.

scenes.heading: A majority acknowledges
scenes.narration: Follower 1 stores the entry and replies. The leader and Follower 1 are two of three servers, which is a majority.

path.label: One acknowledgement is enough for a majority of three.

scenes.heading: Commit, apply, reply
scenes.narration: The leader marks the entry committed, applies it to its state machine, and replies to the client. Followers learn the commit on the next message.

items: Leader applies it to the state machine
Followers apply it after the next AppendEntries

scenes.heading: Why a majority
scenes.narration: When a majority stored the entry, any new leader has it. When only a minority stored it, the entry can be lost. So the leader waits for a majority.

left.label: Majority stored
items: A new leader has the entry

visual.verdict: Commit only after a majority stores the entry.
